editorial:
Imagine being a lonely guy whose whole life is just mixing chemicals to make food taste better. That is where you meet our main character, a divorced man who is pretty much over everything. His life takes a wild turn when he eats a piece of chocolate and suddenly starts seeing a gorgeous woman in his head. He has never met her in real life, but these psychic visions feel way too real to ignore. It starts off like a strange romance, but it quickly turns into a creepy mystery that makes you wonder if he is losing his mind or if something supernatural is actually happening.

What really works here is how the movie builds up the tension without relying on big jump scares. The acting is solid and makes you feel for the guy, though the pacing slows down a bit in the middle. If you like stories where a simple object triggers a nightmare, you will love this. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend. Just make sure you have some snacks ready, though maybe skip the chocolate for this one!
endingExplained: You eventually find out that the woman in the visions is actually a ghost who was murdered. She used the chocolate to connect with the man so he could help her find justice. In the final scenes, the truth about her death comes out and the killer is exposed. Once the mystery is solved and the ghost finds peace, the psychic link breaks, leaving the man to finally move on with his own life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural mysteries and ghostly twists.
